mainEntity.name: Why does administrative decision process matter at the approval stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because expectations stay healthier when outcomes are described honestly, with the real limits created by documents, timing, and authority discretion. Before the next step, administrative decision process usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.
